examples.text: La police mit les menottes au suspect.
examples.en: The police officer put handcuffs on the suspect.

examples.text: La police passa les menottes au suspect.
examples.en: The police officer put handcuffs on the suspect.

examples.text: Tom ne voulait pas que Marie le voie en menottes.
examples.en: Tom didn't want Mary to see him in handcuffs.
